# Bonded Care

> Friendly, dependable everyday help for seniors and their families across Ottawa and surrounding areas — errands, check-ins, deliveries, and home help in a calm, professional "Girl Friday" style.

Bonded Care is a local service founded by Pauline Bond, serving Ottawa, Stittsville, Almonte, Carp, Carleton Place, Richmond, and Munster. Services focus on practical, non-medical support that gives seniors independence and families peace of mind.
